about: Pre-registered player-side live shadows (docs/IMPROVEMENTS.md E1, docs/MLOPS.md section 6). The 2026-27 live season is the confirmatory set. Each arm = the live champion with ONE switch on, projected at the scheduled pregame runs with the champion's seeds and never served (courtside.proj.shadows). Grading: paired arm minus champion on identical rows, DK points, DNP = 0, SE two-way clustered night x player (metrics.paired_cluster2); tiers are the champion's. Edit an entry's bar or metric only before its first graded night; later changes need a new entry (new arm key) so the ledger stays honest.

arms.hypothesis: The upper-tail quantile remap (D6) lowers DK CRPS: harness, live and RotoGuru sets were negative on every set (two-way z -1.2 to -6.2), no tier worse than +2 SE (ledger +tr, 2026-10-23).

Preseason games in the rate state (P3) lower early-season DK CRPS: first 30 days z -1.9 to -3.4 on four seasons, no tier worse than +2 SE; the value is front-loaded (ledger +ep, 2026-10-23). Needs bundle_2026-27_v1_cx_mf_ep.json in var/proj/ (the shadow never fits a bundle).

Keying official injury rows by game date (B8) is a correctness cleanup: P(play) log loss ON-OFF was -0.0005 to -0.0012, never past ~2 SE, and the gain sits in the morning runs (IMPROVEMENTS B8). Bar: not clearly worse on P(play) log loss at the 10:00 run (no tier past +2 SE), and DK CRPS (E[min] >= 10) not worse than +2 SE.

Dropping stale book lines (B9) moves the game environment toward the close (gap 0.364 -> 0.307 in the 11 affected runs of the first 3 nights) and so lowers DK CRPS on the latest run before tip. Descriptive only so far (IMPROVEMENTS B9).
Fit-matched copula tiers (B11) are neutral on DK CRPS by construction (harness |z| <= 0.65, no tier past +1.8; ledger +tm). The shadow only guards against harm; the ship gate is a lineup backtest.

Minutes restrictions parsed from ESPN comments (P7) lower minutes MAE on the restricted rows. Ledger +rs: n = 3 flagged rows, revisit with >= 100 flagged rows. Population = rows whose projection the switch changed, played rows only; DK CRPS (E[min] >= 10) must not be worse than +2 SE.

The lock-10 Questionable refit (P5) lowers DK CRPS (harness -2.7 SE, P(play) log loss -3.2 SE). It acts only once DK starter flags are out, so pregame shadows see it on the latest run before tip at most; expect few changed rows.

Usage v1 redistribution for every absent regular (P8) lowers DK CRPS: harness z -1.8 / -3.3, RotoGuru -2.7 / -4.2, value ranking +2.7 to +4.9 z; the 2025-26 slice was neutral (+0.3 / -0.6), so live is the deciding set (ledger +us, 2026-10-24).
